qaRules: All generated microdetail maps are deterministic and tileable.
Normal maps must import as TextureImporterType.NormalMap with mipmaps and trilinear filtering.
Metallic/smoothness masks must import in linear space; R=metallic and A=smoothness for Unity Standard shader.
Material texture tiling must derive from the recorded physical tile size and metric UVs, not object dimensions.
Macro dirt, rust streaks, splash and runoff are prohibited from these maps and belong to cause-based weathering.
No material may contain a painted/baked sun highlight.
Galvanized steel and cast iron retain metallic response without chrome-like smoothness.
Visual Fidelity points remain unavailable until actual 3840x2160 Unity renders and 100-percent crops are reviewed.
